_comment: Native runtime fingerprints of each shipped native build, per runtime version. scripts/publish-ota.sh refuses to publish a JS OTA whose computed native fingerprint does not match the shipped build for that runtime version. This is the safeguard against the JS<->native skew that black-screened 2.0.10 over OTA (a stale node_modules produced a 2.x AsyncStorage bundle that the 3.x native build could not load). Regenerate with: npx expo-updates fingerprint:generate --platform <ios|android>, and update this file whenever you ship a new native build.
